description: Project module for Pafio project metadata, deterministic dependency resolution, local workflows, vendoring, packaging, and registry clients.
technology_stack: C++ project and package CLI built with CMake and CTest
Python documentation, contract, and interoperability gates
internal_components: Pafio manifest v1, lock, resolution, and deterministic dependency kernel
Content-addressed package cache and offline vendor state
metadata v1 and stable check/build/run/test workflow envelopes
Registry trust, package read client, pack, and publish client
External Styio discovery and compile-plan production
security_boundaries: Pafio is a local client and does not own hosted workspace, cloud job, worker, registry server, or compiler distribution implementations.
Registry responses and package archives are untrusted input and require size, path, hash, and signature validation before materialization.
Pafio must not publish credentials, production keys, tokens, private registry data, personal data, or host-specific paths.
Pafio subprocess execution is limited to the explicitly resolved system Styio binary and rejects shell-command composition.
Pafio never installs, updates, switches, pins, or caches the Styio compiler.

resource_classes.description: Owns pafio.toml, pafio.lock, deterministic resolution, CAS materialization, sync, and vendor state.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Dependency content is keyed by immutable identity and hash; metadata snapshots avoid copying package trees.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Cache writes are staged and atomically promoted per immutable object identity.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing lock, source identity, checksum, or vendor state is explicit and fails closed under locked, offline, or frozen modes.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Failed staging and partial materialization are removed before a transaction reports failure.

state_machine.source: Manifest, resolver, lock, cache, sync, and vendor implementations plus focused native tests.

transitions.on: source, trust, or policy validation fails

required_tests: focused manifest, resolver, lock, CAS, sync, offline, frozen, and vendor tests

resource_classes.description: Owns metadata v1 and stable JSON envelopes for check, build, run, and test.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Machine payloads expose bounded project facts and references rather than compiler-owned diagnostic or runtime internals.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Each workflow performs one sync transaction before plan generation and serializes lock mutation.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Unavailable Styio, targets, lock state, or resolution state is represented by stable structured failure.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Failed workflows remove temporary plans and preserve the last committed project state.

state_machine.source: CLI command dispatch, metadata encoder, workflow envelope encoder, and interop tests.

resource_classes.description: Owns registry trust and reads, source archive packaging, and publish requests to the Platform registry control plane.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Archives stream bounded files and registry payloads retain immutable object identities.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Publish and cache writes use isolated staging and idempotent server request identifiers.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing trust roots, package identities, checksums, or publish responses fail closed.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Temporary archives, downloads, and staging directories are removed after success or failure.

state_machine.source: Registry client, pack/publish commands, archive validation, and Platform interoperability tests.

transitions.on: any trust or policy check fails

required_tests: registry trust and malicious archive tests
